description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving employee leave balance data within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for fetching leave balances, handling request parameters, and defining response schemas.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for fetching employee leave balances and related leave data, with integrated validation, parameter handling, and response formatting.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of employee leave balances based on provided query parameters, including date range, employee number, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaveBalancesResult
methods.description: Constructs an array of leave balance data for each leave type, including entitlement, used, scheduled, pending, taken, and balance figures, filtered by employee and date range.

methods.name: getFromAndToDates
methods.description: Determines the date range for the leave balance query, either from request parameters or the current leave period, with validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET endpoint, specifying required and optional query parameters with data type constraints.
